projects.title: HimalSnow: AI-Powered Snow Cover Monitoring System
projects.subtitle: Real-time Snow Cover Analysis for Northwest Himalaya
projects.description: Developed an automated system for monitoring snow cover dynamics in the Northwest Himalayan region using multi-sensor satellite data. The system processes MODIS, Sentinel-2, and Landsat imagery to provide near real-time snow cover area mapping and trend analysis.
projects.detailed_description: This project addressed the critical need for accurate snow cover monitoring in the Himalayan region, where seasonal snow plays a vital role in water resources. Using Google Earth Engine platform, I developed algorithms that process thousands of satellite images to track snow cover changes with 95% accuracy. The system has been used to study climate change impacts on Himalayan glaciers.
features: Automated cloud masking and snow detection
Multi-temporal analysis of 20+ years of data
Climate trend analysis and statistical modeling
outcomes: Published research paper in Remote Sensing journal
Improved accuracy by 15% over existing methods
Dataset used by 5+ research institutions
Presented at international conferences

projects.title: DroughtWatch India: ML-Based Drought Forecasting Platform
projects.subtitle: Sub-seasonal to Seasonal Agricultural Drought Prediction
projects.description: Built a machine learning framework for predicting agricultural droughts across India using 30+ years of satellite data, meteorological records, and soil moisture indices. The system provides early warnings up to 3 months in advance.
projects.detailed_description: Agricultural drought impacts millions of farmers in India annually. This project developed a sophisticated ML pipeline that combines multiple drought indices (SPEI, VCI, SPI) with Random Forest and LSTM models to predict drought conditions. The system analyzes historical patterns and current conditions to provide actionable forecasts for agricultural planning.
features: Multi-index drought monitoring (SPEI, VCI, TCI, VHI)
Machine learning models for 1-3 month forecasts
outcomes: Published in Journal of Environmental Management
75% forecast accuracy for 2-month predictions
Presented at National Workshop on Drought Monitoring
Adopted by state agricultural departments for pilot testing

projects.title: AirSense: Multi-Pollutant Tracking System
projects.subtitle: 3D Visualization of Air Quality over Indo-Gangetic Plain
projects.description: Developed an integrated system for tracking and visualizing horizontal and vertical distribution of air pollutants (PM2.5, NO2, CO, SO2) over the Indo-Gangetic Plain using ground sensors and CALIPSO LIDAR satellite data.
projects.detailed_description: Air pollution in the Indo-Gangetic Plain affects over 400 million people. This project combined ground-based observations with satellite LIDAR data to create 3D visualizations of pollutant distribution. The system revealed critical patterns in aerosol transport and helped identify pollution sources and their vertical extent in the atmosphere.
features: Integration of satellite and ground sensor data
outcomes: Presented at Asian Air Pollution Workshop (AAPW-5)
Identified major dust transport events from Middle East
Dataset spans 2 years with daily measurements
Contributed to air quality policy discussions

projects.title: ForestSpec: Hyperspectral Tree Species Classifier
projects.subtitle: Deep Learning for Himalayan Forest Mapping
projects.description: Created a comprehensive spectral library and deep learning classifier for identifying Himalayan forest tree species using hyperspectral imagery and field spectroradiometer data.
projects.detailed_description: Accurate tree species identification is crucial for forest conservation. This project built a spectral library of 30+ Himalayan tree species using ASD FieldSpec spectroradiometer and developed a CNN-based classifier for automated species mapping from airborne hyperspectral data. The system links spectral signatures to biophysical parameters like chlorophyll content and leaf area index.
features: Spectral library of 30+ tree species (400-2500 nm)
outcomes: Spectral library adopted by research institutions
92% species classification accuracy
Data collection across 15 forest sites
Contributed to biodiversity monitoring efforts

projects.title: ThunderTrack: Urban Thunderstorm Prediction System
projects.subtitle: High-Resolution Mesoscale Modeling for Indian Cities
projects.description: Developing a high-resolution weather prediction system for forecasting thunderstorms over major Indian cities using WRF model and analyzing land-atmosphere interactions during extreme weather events.
projects.detailed_description: Urban areas face increasing thunderstorm risks due to rapid urbanization and climate change. This ongoing project uses the WRF-CHEM mesoscale model at 1km resolution to predict thunderstorm formation and evolution over major Indian cities. The research focuses on understanding how urban land use affects convective processes and storm intensity.
features: Integration with satellite and radar data
outcomes: Research ongoing at NIT Rourkela
Preliminary results show 24-hour forecast skill
Collaboration with meteorological departments
Expected publications in 2024
